verdict.rationale: Jeeves's marketing pages say teams can invite members and "customize roles & permissions", manage user permissions, and apply employee permissions alongside departmental budget controls. These are short claims with no detail on how granular the role model is. Nothing shows permissions scoped by location or department, as opposed to budget controls scoped by department. Missing for 10: granular role/permission model documentation, location-scoped permissions, department-scoped permissions (beyond budgets), independent or hands-on corroboration.
